subject: Helix Systems — Renewal + AWS Marketplace billing bridge
messages:
From: Ava Reed <ava.reed@helixsys.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Zhou <matt.zhou@helixsys.com>, procurement@helixsys.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + marketplace billing question

Sean — thanks for the call this morning. Quick follow-up from our procurement team: we renewed last year on a direct contract and our finance team is pushing to move all SaaS spend to AWS Marketplace for centralized invoicing. Renewal is due 2028-06-15.

Can Redwood support a near-term transition for the renewal date so invoices land in our AWS Marketplace account? If so what does that workflow look like and what do we need to sign on our side?

Also we are expanding usage across two additional business units (estimated +40% spend). Would that require a separate listing or just an amendment in Marketplace?

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Reed
Director of Cloud Ops — Helix Systems
ava.reed@helixsys.com

Attachment: Helix_renewal_summary.pdf (stub)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Reed <ava.reed@helixsys.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + marketplace billing question

Hi Ava — great to hear. Short answer: yes, we can transition the renewal to AWS Marketplace and support the expansion without creating a new listing. High-level steps:

- Redwood creates a marketplace amendment (invoice routing + entitlement mapping).
- Helix accepts the marketplace terms in AWS (DocuSign/Marketplace acceptance link).
- We align on effective cutover date (we recommend last day of the current billing month to avoid pro-ration complexity).
- Sales Ops issues a marketplace quote (attached) and we exchange an SOW appendix for the expansion.

I'll loop in Vanessa (partner/channel) and Karthik (sales ops) for the technical handoff and migration checklist.

If you can confirm targeted spend and the customer account ID for AWS Marketplace, we can draft the amendment this afternoon.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Ava — copying Sales Ops and Finance to detail the runbook. A couple of quick clarifications we need from Helix to avoid delays:

1) AWS Marketplace Customer ID (the 12-digit account number you accept offers under)
2) Which business units should be included under the same entitlements (list of legal entity names)
3) Any PO number requirements or internal billing codes you need on the invoice

Once we have those we will:
- Upload the listing amendment and pricing to the Marketplace catalog
- Send the DocuSign link for Helix to accept marketplace terms
- Set a targeted cutover of 2028-06-01 (we can adjust to 06-15 if you prefer)

Karthik — please prepare the marketplace quote and populate the migration checklist (I attached a template). Naomi — can you confirm whether the co-sell team needs to re-submit for AWS co-sell approval given the expansion?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Team — attaching the populated checklist and the marketplace quote. Key notes:

- Quote mirrors current pricing for the renewal term (12 months) and includes a 5% volume discount for the expansion.
- We will ingest Helix’s CostCenter and PO# fields into the invoice metadata on Marketplace invoices (AWS supports custom invoice fields via consolidated billing — see notes).
- DocuSign link below will be used for the Helix acceptance of Marketplace terms; once signed, AWS will schedule offer activation (typically 24–48 hrs).
- Cutover plan: switch invoice routing on 2028-06-01 at 00:00 UTC; any usage before that will be billed under the existing contract.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/helix/aws-mkt-invoice-acceptance
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HLX-2028-REN-01

Sean — please confirm that Finance is ok with the 5% discount and we can send the DocuSign to Helix procurement today.

Karthik
